summary: Executed pytest suite (18 tests, 17 passing) covering all backend analytics endpoints and performed Playwright smoke of all 10 frontend routes. Backend is largely healthy — only /api/eda/scatter fails (500) when x or y is 'Overall' due to a duplicate-column bug. Frontend loads on every route; Dashboard hero shows 18,147 / 164; top-value table renders 10 rows and player-profile modal opens; Explorer search filters to Messi; EDA renders 6 charts + 4-row summary table; Statistics shows Reject H₀; Correlation heatmap renders with Potential at top; Categorical shows χ²; Scouting Brief renders 5 findings + signature bar chart + takeaways; Dataset export button present; mobile hamburger opens. Visualizations page is degraded because its scatter chart depends on the failing scatter endpoint.

critical.issue: Returns 500 whenever x or y is 'Overall'. server.py line 326 does `DF.sample(...)[[x, y, 'Name', 'pos_group', 'Overall']]` — when x=='Overall' the resulting DataFrame has two 'Overall' columns, so `r['Overall']` in the comprehension returns a pandas Series and `int(...)` raises TypeError. Fix: dedupe the column list, e.g. `cols = list(dict.fromkeys([x, y, 'Name', 'pos_group', 'Overall']))` then `sub = DF.sample(...)[cols]`.

ui_bugs.issue: Scatter (Overall vs Value_EUR) shows no data due to backend /api/eda/scatter 500. Only 2 of the expected 4 charts render fully; console shows 500 responses.
React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop.' emitted from CorrelationHeatmap render. Add stable keys to mapped cells/rows.

Repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' across multiple pages (Dashboard, EDA, Visualizations, Correlation). Charts sometimes render with 0-height parent on first paint. Add explicit min-height to containers or set aspect.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend fetch to /api/eda/scatter fails (500) whenever Overall is on either axis — user-visible broken chart on default load.

issues: Player Photo and Flag URLs (cdn.sofifa.org / *.png externals) fail with ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED in this preview environment — dozens of broken-image icons. Consider a local placeholder or referrer-safe proxy; at minimum add onError fallback so avatars don't look broken.

action_items: Fix /api/eda/scatter duplicate-column crash (dedupe columns list in server.py ~L326).
Add unique key prop in CorrelationHeatmap.jsx map.
Add onError image fallback for Photo/Flag so broken external images degrade gracefully.
Ensure Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents have non-zero initial height (add min-h class) to silence width/-1 warnings and prevent first-paint empty charts.
Consider adding finer data-testid hooks on Scouting cards and Explorer search input for future regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py eda_scatter: column-selection bug (duplicate 'Overall') is a latent crash whenever a caller reuses one of the built-in included columns as x/y. Same defensive pattern should be applied anywhere columns are hard-coded alongside dynamic args.
CorrelationHeatmap missing React keys — will hurt reconciliation on re-render.
Numerous Recharts containers rely on 100% parent height without a min-height; on first render this causes width/height=-1 warnings.
Frontend consumes /stats/normality directly (shapiro.p, dagostino.p) — response schema not documented; consider normalizing key names (p vs p_value) across endpoints for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 18 cases). After main agent patches server.py eda_scatter, rerun `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` and revisit /visualizations to confirm scatter renders. Frontend base URL taken from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://scout-data-pro.preview.emergentagent.com). All other endpoints and pages verified working.
rca of the issue: eda_scatter constructs a subframe with `DF.sample(...)[[x, y, 'Name', 'pos_group', 'Overall']]`. When x or y equals 'Overall' (the default frontend axis), the projection selects two identically named columns; pandas then returns a Series for r['Overall'] during row iteration, and int(Series) raises TypeError, surfaced as HTTP 500. Reproduction: `curl '$BASE/api/eda/scatter?x=Overall&y=Value_EUR&sample=500'`. Mitigation: dedupe columns list before selection, e.g. cols = list(dict.fromkeys([x, y, 'Name', 'pos_group', 'Overall'])).
